get.description: This API is used to retrieve a customer's application profile for a given *appid* and *user ID*.

parameters.description: The ID of the app asset that you can obtain from imiconnect platform
parameters.name: appid

parameters.description: Unique ID for a mobile/web app user
parameters.name: userid

parameters.description: Client key that can be accessed from your app asset configuration page on imiconnect platform
parameters.name: secretKey

get.summary: Get App Profile by User ID

code-samples.code:
require 'httparty'
# Create the HTTP objects and post request
http = HTTParty.get("https://api.imiconnect.io/resources/v2/customerappprofile/{inappid}?identifier={userId}",
    :headers => {'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
	'key' => ' Profile key present in tenant setting’})
# Print on console
puts http

import requests

url = " https://api.imiconnect.io/resources/v2/customerappprofile/{inappid}?identifier={userId}");"

headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'key': ' Profile key present in tenant setting '}

response = requests.request("GET", url, headers=headers)

print(response.text)
